description: Standalone PDF annotation workbench built on top of TmPdfViewer. Offers highlight, comment, stamp, and freehand drawing tools in a single hierarchical toolbar (the annotator's groups are merged into the viewer toolbar through its ToolbarStart/ToolbarEnd slots, with an optional header row for the title/subtitle and the export group), a comment thread panel with resolve/reopen, per-author or per-role annotation colors, pass-through access to the viewer's thumbnails, search, rotation, zoom mode and open link, export of annotations into the PDF (as real PDF annotations or flattened into the page content), and a print variant with a comment summary. Persistence is pluggable through IPdfAnnotationProvider.

parameters.name: Url
parameters.description: URL of the PDF document to annotate.

parameters.name: DocumentId
parameters.description: Stable document identifier used by the annotation provider. Falls back to Url.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: Height of the annotator (CSS value). Default is "600px".

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the root element.

parameters.name: AnnotationProvider
parameters.description: Provider used to load and persist annotation threads. When omitted, an in-memory provider keeps annotations for the lifetime of the component.

parameters.name: CurrentUser
parameters.description: Author applied to annotations created in this annotator.

parameters.name: Users
parameters.description: Known users, used to resolve author roles for role-based colors.

parameters.name: AuthorColors
parameters.description: Annotation colors per author, keyed by user id.

parameters.name: RoleColors
parameters.description: Annotation colors per role, keyed by role.

parameters.name: AnnotationColor
parameters.description: Explicit color (CSS value) stored with annotations created in this annotator. When null (default) colors resolve per author/role at display time.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Active tool. Supports two-way binding. Default is Browse.

parameters.name: ModeChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the active tool changes.

parameters.name: StampOptions
parameters.description: Stamp texts offered in stamp mode. Defaults to localized Approved/Rejected/Draft/Confidential.

parameters.name: ShowResolved
parameters.description: Whether resolved annotation threads are shown by default. Default is false.

parameters.name: ShowResolvedChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the resolved filter toggles.

parameters.name: ShowPanel
parameters.description: Whether the thread panel is rendered. Default is true.

parameters.name: ShowPanelChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the panel's close button requests to hide the panel (two-way ShowPanel binding).

parameters.name: ShowViewerToolbar
parameters.description: Kept for backward compatibility. When true (default) the annotator has no toolbar of its own: its tool groups merge into the embedded viewer's single toolbar through the viewer's ToolbarStart/ToolbarEnd slots, and the export group lives in the header row when ShowHeader is true. When false the viewer's chrome (navigation, zoom, rotation) is hidden and the annotator renders a compact tools row of its own instead.

parameters.name: ShowOpenLink
parameters.description: Whether the "Open in new tab" link is rendered (in the merged toolbar, or in the header row when ShowHeader is true). Default is true.

parameters.name: ShowThumbnails
parameters.description: Whether the viewer's thumbnails sidebar is offered. Default is false; passed through to the embedded viewer.

parameters.name: ShowSearch
parameters.description: Whether the viewer's search is offered. Default is false; passed through to the embedded viewer.

parameters.name: AllowRotation
parameters.description: Whether the viewer's rotation button is offered. Default is false; passed through to the embedded viewer.

parameters.name: ThumbnailsCollapsed
parameters.description: Whether the thumbnails sidebar is collapsed. Supports two-way binding; the annotator tracks the state so an unbound host keeps the user's choice. Default is false.

parameters.name: ThumbnailsCollapsedChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the thumbnails collapse state changes in the viewer.

parameters.name: ZoomMode
parameters.description: How the viewer's zoom scale is decided. Supports two-way binding; passed through to the embedded viewer. Default is Custom.

parameters.name: ZoomModeChanged
parameters.description: Callback when the zoom mode changes in the viewer.

parameters.name: ShowHeader
parameters.description: Whether a header row (title, subtitle, export group and host actions) is rendered above the merged toolbar. Default is false.

parameters.name: Title
parameters.description: Document title rendered in the header row. Used only when ShowHeader is true.

parameters.name: Subtitle
parameters.description: Document subtitle rendered in the header row. Used only when ShowHeader is true; when omitted the viewer shows a neutral page count.

parameters.name: HeaderStart
parameters.description: Content rendered at the start of the header row. Used only when ShowHeader is true.

parameters.name: HeaderActions
parameters.description: Extra host actions rendered at the end of the header row, after the export group. Used only when ShowHeader is true.

parameters.name: AllowExport
parameters.description: Whether export and print actions are offered. Default is true.

parameters.name: ExportFileName
parameters.description: File name used for the exported PDF. Defaults to the source name with an "-annotated" suffix.

parameters.name: AnnotationsChanged
parameters.description: Callback invoked when the loaded annotation set changes.
